**Ready for the maintainer to merge.**

## What looks good

- One flag for everything: `LeafNode::collapsed` reads through the dock's arrow, the saved setups and the fold law, which is the decision the issue asked for. The fold law stores the open share, holds the split at chip width every frame and restores it on unfold, so a resize or a drag cannot widen (or unfold) a folded pane.
- The viewport is protected by name (`the_viewport_never_folds`), and the setups carry the `camcraft_pane_folds` mark plus the open shares, so a setup saved by an older build loads with every pane unfolded and a new setup round-trips the folds and widths.
- Every folded chip keeps the safety state as text with a glyph (check mark / warning sign), read live from `status_of`, `stale_reason` and `tool_problem_of`, per the #4245 E2 rule; an open dock pays nothing for it.
- Tests are pinned at the right place (`pane_fold.rs` in the ui directory suite, `page_layout::layout_shell_folded`, kit unit tests), and the `crates/ui` test count goes from 2019 to 2032.
- No snapshot PNG changes, no command queue change (layout is view state), no new dependency, no process file change. Provenance lines on the three new modules.

## Results (merged with main 2394b5ad1)

Runner run `46100970472` (self-hosted, Linux): trial merge clean; quick gate 20 steps, 0 failed, 0 stalled (`ui-kit suites: lib` 25s ok; `ui build` 319s ok; `ui suites: lib` 89s ok; 16 `ui suites` binaries ok; site tests SKIPPED, not applicable; it is not the site's diff). clippy on the runner failed because `cargo-clippy` is not installed for the runner's toolchain (`error: 'cargo-clippy' is not installed for the toolchain 'stable-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu'`), an environment gap, not a code finding. Local clippy on the touched crates (`camcraft-ui`, `camcraft-ui-kit`, `--all-targets -- -D warnings`): clean. No cfg(windows) or per-OS change in this diff, so no local Windows-only suites owed.

## Targeted tests

- `layout_shell_folded` and `pane_fold` (12 tests): all pass on the runner's quick gate; kit 7 tests too.
- Light lane (local, this head): `cargo xtask gate light --base origin/main` — 4 steps, 0 failed, 0 stalled (`light build` 3s ok; `motion light: lib` 295s ok; `motion light: adaptive2d` 46s ok; `app light: pocket_pass_start` 2s ok; 11 light twins). The diff touches no post and no toolpath, so no example catalog suite is owed.
- Heavy step: none owed (P6, not a safety-floor PR).

## Requested before merge

None.

## Questions / notes (not blocking)

- The fold law's `folded_side_panes` reads the leaf rect before the dock lays out on the first frame after a load; the `chip_rect` guard and the `span` refresh keep this harmless, and the test `a_saved_setup_keeps_its_folds_and_their_open_width` covers the round trip. Not a blocker.
- The runner's clippy gap is environmental; worth a maintainer look at the runner image (install `cargo-clippy` for the toolchain), not a PR change.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
